title: TreviPay - Best suited to high-volume B2B sellers, not a quick setup
clean_text: Reviewers describe TreviPay as reliable for structured pay-by-invoice programs, but note it may not be the best fit for businesses that do not have a high volume of B2B transactions, since it requires meaningful time and resources to set up and customize the platform for a given seller's trade credit program. Some mid-market suppliers reportedly compare TreviPay against faster-to-connect alternatives when their priority is rapid impact on cash-flow goals rather than a fully custom branded network.
